editorial: Neon strobe lights blur as you watch a quartet chase money in a high stake corridor of desire. Unlike typical heist flicks, the film layers each character’s ambition with their own moral decline. Sofia’s desperate negotiation with her conscience, played in long uninterrupted takes, anchors the tension. You will feel at home with this dark, character driven thriller that rewards a patient viewer. The midpoint slowdown dips momentum, but the payoff reclaims the pace.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
